description: Comprehensive UC undergraduate admissions data including applications, admits, and enrollees broken down by campus, year, ethnicity, residency, first-generation status, income, and geographic origins. Data sourced from the UC Accountability Report 2025 (Chapter 1: Admissions & Enrollment, Chapter 7: Diversity) and UC Information Center Tableau dashboards.
data_notes: Systemwide applicant and admit counts are unduplicated (students applying to multiple campuses counted once).
UC Merced opened in 2005; no data prior to 2005 for that campus.
Beginning in 2011, Merced only formally admitted referral students who accepted the invitation, causing an apparent drop in admits.
Cells with 1-4 students have been redacted with additional redactions to prevent deduction.
Campus-level historical data (pre-2020) is available via Tableau dashboards but requires interactive browser access to export.
The Tableau CSV export for ethnicity data shows the default view (appears to be applicants). Admits and enrollees by ethnicity require interactive filter changes.
